title: Composed supervisory control: Alternating two-pump starts -> Lead-lag pump demand control

inputs.name: B_LowDemand
inputs.description: Subsystem B: At least one pump is required

inputs.name: B_HighDemand
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Both pumps are requested

inputs.name: B_LeadIsPump1
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Pump 1 is selected lead

outputs.name: A_NextPump
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Preferred pump for next demand: 1 or 2

outputs.name: A_Unavailable
outputs.description: Subsystem A: No available pump for demand

outputs.name: B_CapacityShortfall
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Requested capacity cannot be supplied

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: Each rising A_Demand shall start at most one available pump.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: When both pumps are available, successive A_Demand episodes shall alternate the selected pump.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: If the preferred pump is A_Unavailable, the other available pump shall run.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Unavailable shall be TRUE exactly when A_Demand is TRUE and neither pump is available.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset without A_Demand shall set A_NextPump to 1 and stop both pumps.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: With B_LowDemand only, the available selected lead pump shall run and the lag pump shall remain off.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_LowDemand AND !B_HighDemand AND lead_available) -> exactly_one_run))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: With B_HighDemand, every available pump shall run.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: If the selected lead is unavailable under B_LowDemand, the available lag pump shall run.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_LowDemand AND !B_HighDemand AND !lead_available AND lag_available) -> lag_runs))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: No pump shall run when neither demand input is TRUE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_CapacityShortfall shall indicate zero available pumps for B_LowDemand or fewer than two for B_HighDemand.
A TRUE A_Pump1Run shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_Pump1Run AND NOT B_Pump2Run AND NOT B_CapacityShortfall)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_Pump1Run AND NOT B_Pump2Run AND NOT B_CapacityShortfall))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
